sentences.text:
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
 1
21.11.2019
Ct-34 ar C.R.R 848 of 2006 M/s. Sri Balaji Stores & Ors.
Vs. The State of West Bengal
No accommodation has been sought for.

The revisional application has been filed for quashing the judgment dated 25.01.2006 passed by the learned Municipal Magistrate, Calcutta, under Section 16(1)a(i) read with Section 7 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
I find from the said judgment that the petitioners were convicted and sentenced to undergo imprisonment for one year along with a fine of Rs.2,000/-, I.d S.I for six months.
The said judgment and order passed by the learned Court below is appealable and as such no revision lies.

However, the records of the revisional application reflect that on 28.3.2006 when the revisional application appeared before a coordinate bench of this Court none appeared and there was a direction for the matter to go out of the list.
In view of the observation made above, CRR 848 of 2006 is dismissed.

(Tirthankar Ghosh,J.)
